wallet_is_claimed.meaning: AtomWallet.isClaimed is true (wallet has been claimed)

userop_reaches_validation.meaning: a UserOp for the AtomWallet is submitted and reaches validateUserOp during the validation phase

userop_rejected_at_simulation_occurs.meaning: the UserOp is rejected at simulation by an ERC-7562-compliant bundler
userop_rejected_at_simulation_occurs.checkpoint: after bundler simulation of the validation phase

assumptions: The bundler is ERC-7562-compliant and performs simulation of the validation phase.
The UserOp is directed at the unclaimed AtomWallet and its validation path invokes owner()/getAtomWarden().

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the UserOp is actually submitted in a real transaction; rejection is described as a conditional simulation outcome, so the effect is formalized only as the simulation-rejection observable.
Report does not specify the exact caller/actor submitting the UserOp beyond the wallet being unclaimed.

limitations: The claim that every unclaimed wallet is affected is a scope generalization; this plan formalizes the single-wallet simulation-rejection scenario.
The associated-storage requirement (intent_associated_storage_only) is not encoded as a predicate here; only the acceptance obligation for the unclaimed-wallet scenario is formalized.
